summary: Retest of the iteration-9 fixes on the cloud target. All requested fixes work. (1) The frame matches the browser area: frame-image naturalWidth/Height == /api/browser/state viewport == browser-screen size after login (1058x821, even when the group was first forced to a stale 1280x800), after reload, after switching workspaces, after opening the solo pop-out (1102x688), after toggling the left, right and workspace-bar panels, after dragging the resize handle and after opening/closing tabs. iter9_main_probe: the reconnect and animated sessions show only (1058,821). (2) Clicks map to the right spot: clicking the Wikipedia search icon opened the search box, typed 'Alan Turing' appeared in it with suggestions, and Enter navigated to /wiki/Alan_Turing. (3) WebSocket close codes: invalid token gives 4401 and a bad group gives 4400. (4) The solo pop-out has no toggle-workspace-bar, toggle-left-panel, side-rail or group-bar; toggle-right-panel and solo-group-name are present. (5) HistoryPanel hover border is light (#DADCE0 -> #BDC1C6). Template skill picker is a shadcn Select (role=combobox); picking 'Example learn more' shows the instructions field, and saving persists skill_id and instructions (checked via the API). The Reports date button opens the shadcn Calendar, future days are disabled (24 disabled cells), picking Nov 1 loaded that day, and prev/next still work. (6) Regression checks passed: test_iter9_stream.py 7/7 (WS fps 60), UI fps 47 on an animated page, Live indicator on, workspace switch and tabs work. Two minor findings, listed below.

minor.issue: Brief stale frames on first connect: about 300-450ms show a 1280x800 frame at the old viewport, then a 1031x800 frame (new page scaled into the old maxWidth/maxHeight), before the correct 1058x821. Seen in iter9_main_probe's first session and in the UI sampler right after login. It fixes itself quickly, so it is cosmetic.

ui_bugs.issue: The Calendar popover stays open after picking a day. The date does load, but users usually expect the popover to close on select.

action_items: Optional: remove the stale first frames. Either have the client pass width/height as WS query params so the viewport is applied before the first screenshot, or update self.viewport before the per-page set_viewport_size loop and drop screencast frames whose metadata deviceWidth/Height differ from the viewport
Optional: make the Reports Popover controlled (open/onOpenChange) and close it in onSelect
critical_code_review_comments: BrowserView.point() still maps clicks with state.viewport, not imgRef.naturalWidth/Height. It works now because the sizes match, but using the natural size would cover the transient window and the 1s state polling lag
When two windows show the same group (main plus solo pop-out), each sends its own resize and the last one wins, so the other window is letterboxed. This is acceptable but worth knowing
ReportsPanel uses toLocaleDateString('en-CA') in the browser's local time while the report label says UTC. Days can be off by one near midnight for non-UTC users
updated_files: /app/tests/iter10_setvp.py (new helper: force a group's viewport via WS resize)
seed_data_creation: Created a TEST_wiki workspace (a13f349e) and a TEST_tpl_iter10 template. Both were deleted by id. Group 1 viewport was restored to 1058x821. The user's Main and 'SEARCH FOR EVENTS ONLINE' workspaces are unchanged.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Clerk sign-in tickets are single-use: regenerate /tmp/tk.txt (python /app/tests/clerk_token.py shadow.a+clerk_test@example.com ticket > /tmp/tk.txt) before every browser_automation session. Group is held in memory (lib/api currentGroup), not localStorage, so pass the group id explicitly when querying /api/browser/state. Popup windows in headless mode report naturalWidth 0 until bring_to_front() is called. To simulate a stale viewport, run python /app/tests/iter10_setvp.py 1 1280 800 before login.
rca of the issue: Stale first frames: Group.stream sends page.screenshot() right away at the current self.viewport, before the client's resize message is processed. set_viewport then resizes pages while the old screencast is still running with the old maxWidth/maxHeight (1280x800), so one 1031x800 frame (1058x821 scaled to fit) is emitted before the loop notices the key change and restarts the screencast.
